policy: Three source-bound upper reconstructions only: Emmaus, Apostel-Paulus and LUX/Narva. Every earlier packet, source envelope and navigation record stays byte-identical. New geometry begins above each family's retained body. Parish overall heights 74/86 m and mapped LUX height 63 m are distinct from estimated shaft widths, stage heights, clock faces and decorative fittings. All new plan vertices remain within the mapped source owner. Native geometry is independently orthogonal. No new terrain, navigation, texture, animation, coverage, tour stop or live residency allowance.
dimensionStatus: OSM perimeter and complete retained LoD2 sheets are source coordinates. Parish heights are published overall dimensions, not individual surveys. LUX 63 m/16 levels is explicit OSM evidence. All intermediate stage heights, shafts, spire proportions, corner pinnacles, clocks, glazing and materials are reference-guided display estimates. No independent surveyed church tower-only polygon exists in the retained OSM extract.
